title: English grammar
description: Ngữ pháp tiếng Anh từ A1 đến C2: mỗi bài một điểm ngữ pháp, xếp theo thứ tự bài trước bổ trợ bài sau (đang soạn).

title: Top 150 phrasal verbs
description: The 150 most frequent English phrasal verbs, ordered by how often they are used, with their main meanings.
source: Written by the Alavo team. The word list and its order follow the PHaVE List (Garnier & Schmitt, 2015); definitions, translations and examples are original.

title: TOEIC Service List
description: The 1,250 words that appear most often in TOEIC test materials, ordered by rank, with Vietnamese meanings and examples.
source: Word list: TOEIC Service List 1.2 by Charles Browne and Brent Culligan (https://www.newgeneralservicelist.com/toeic-service-list), CC BY-SA 4.0. Phonetics, definitions, translations and examples written by the Alavo team.

title: 650 everyday collocations
description: 650 common word combinations used in daily life, such as make a decision and heavy rain, with Vietnamese meanings and examples.
source: Written by the Alavo team. Collocations chosen by hand from everyday topics and checked against entries in the Oxford Learner's Dictionaries and the Longman Dictionary of Contemporary English; definitions, translations and examples are original.

title: 230 common prepositional verbs
description: 230 common English verbs that take a fixed preposition, such as depend on, think about, talk to and ask for, with Vietnamese meanings, the patterns they follow and examples.
source: Written by the Alavo team. Pairs come from nine published teaching lists, kept when Longman (LDOCE) also lists the pattern, ordered by how many lists include them. Definitions follow LDOCE; translations and examples are original.

title: 275 common fixed expressions
description: 275 common fixed expressions such as by the way, no worries and sooner or later, with Vietnamese meanings and examples.
source: Written by the Alavo team. Expressions chosen by hand for everyday speech and writing, kept when Longman (LDOCE) lists them as an entry or phrase; definitions paraphrase LDOCE; translations and examples are original.
